end.parentNote: Dev practised examples of traditional nature protection, including Bishnoi communities, sacred groves, and tree protection. Dev used the method of linking each practice to an effect, such as bird habitats, soil staying in place, and neem leaves keeping insects away. Dev described Bishnoi tree protection using tree-hugging, which was not shown as corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask Dev to sort three cards—Bishnoi, sacred groves, and Chipko—and say one nature-protecting action for each.
